name: animal-zoo-healthy
note: L8 healthy zoo variants (amb.lion, amb.gorilla, amb.flamingo; static rest pose) beside the shipped infected animals (idle) at the game camera, golden light: same scale, stance and silhouette; healthy has intact fur/plumage, closed mouth and dark eyes, no wounds or red glow. Look for: size/proportion match with the infected base, grounded paws and feet (nothing floating or sunk), no missing parts or flat panels, no perforated look.
